newsitem.title: USA: Lund Food Holdings agrees to buy Byerly's.
newsitem.headline: Lund Food Holdings agrees to buy Byerly's.

text.p: Lund Food Holdings Inc, parent of Lunds Food Stores, said Tuesday it had agreed to acquire the Byerly's grocery chain from Minneapolis-based investment firm Goldner Hawn Johnson & Morrison Inc for undisclosed terms.
The agreement includes 11 stores operating in the Minneapolis-St. Paul and St. Cloud, Minn., area.
Lund said two Chicago-area Byerly's stores have been sold to Dominick's Supermarkets Inc.
The sale of the two stores to Dominick's was prompted by Lund's decision to maintain retail operations only in Minnesota.
Lund Food Stores operate eight stores in the Twin Cities area.
Though Lund and Byerly's will be under the ownership of Lund Food Holdings, the company said the businesses will maintain separate identities.
Dominick's spokesmen were not available for comment.
